title: REQ-SAG-0143 and REQ-SAG-0403 are Active in the root requirements, but the crate requirement tables have no row for them
description: REQ-SAG-0143 and REQ-SAG-0403 are Active in the root requirements, but the crate requirement tables have no row for them. docs/sc-decision-schema/requirements.md lists 0140-0146 and omits 0143, though jev::v1 lives in that crate. docs/sc-jev/requirements.md describes 0403 and 0143 only in prose under 'Phase A.1 (r-5)', with no table row. The crate-level REQ-SAG-0103 row (sc-decision-schema/requirements.md:14) does not mention the additive kind and descriptions fields.
